title: Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28611v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement-learning agents shape the observations they encounter; consequently, detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) states requires analysing action-conditioned trajectories rather than treating inputs as independent samples. We propose Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility (ACTI), a detector that evaluates forward and backward transition likelihoods, calibrates this comparison against the in-distribution profile at each timestep, and smooths the score over a short window, using no future information. We tested ACTI across six environments and fifteen detectors within OOD-RL-Bench, using the four anomaly mechanisms that qualified in every environment, with ten policy replicates per environment. All primary metrics are matched-time: each score after anomaly onset is compared with a clean twin rollout's score at the same timestep. translated_title: 基于动作条件转移不可逆性的强化学习分布外检测
translated_abstract: 强化学习智能体会塑造它们所遇到的观测结果；因此，检测分布外（OOD）状态需要分析以动作为条件的轨迹，而不是将输入视为独立样本。我们提出了动作条件转移不可逆性（Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility, ACTI），这是一种检测器，它通过评估前向和后向转移似然，在每个时间步将该比较与分布内特征进行校准，并在短窗口上平滑分数，且不使用任何未来信息。我们在OOD-RL-Bench中跨六个环境和十五个检测器对ACTI进行了测试，使用了在每个环境中均合格的四种异常机制，每个环境包含十个策略副本。所有主要指标均为匹配时间指标：异常发生后的每个分数都与相同时间步的干净孪生rollout的分数进行比较。我们的方法获得了最高的宏观匹配时间AUROC，优于动力学模型基线。
tldr: 本文提出动作条件转移不可逆性（ACTI）检测方法，通过评估前向和后向转移似然并在每个时间步进行分布内校准，在强化学习分布外状态检测中取得了最佳的匹配时间AUROC性能。
en_tdlr: We propose Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility (ACTI), an OOD detection method for reinforcement learning that evaluates forward and backward transition likelihoods with per-timestep in-distribution calibration, achieving top macro matched-time AUROC across six environments.
